title: Exploiting Cultural Biases via Homoglyphs in Text-to-Image Synthesis
reasoning: The paper focuses on cultural and ethnic biases in generative image models. While it includes 'religious buildings' as one of the categories in its miscellaneous dataset prompts and discusses ethical implications in a dedicated section, the primary focus is on the technical mechanism of homoglyph-induced bias and its mitigation rather than a specialized evaluation of religion, faith, or moral/ethical systems.
